import numpy as np
edges=np.arange(0.5,10.01,0.5)
for lo,hi in zip(edges[:-1],edges[1:]):
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<hi)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    X=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),A[m],A[m]**2]
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r=dA_dt[m]-X@c
    print(f"{lo:.1f}-{hi:.1f} n={m.sum()} a={c[0]:.3f} b={c[1]:.3f} c={c[2]:.3f} rms={np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2)):.3f}")
